name: AWS CloudTrail - Internet Gateway Changes

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail  (*Gateway)
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name 
| where event_name in ("CreateCustomerGateway","DeleteCustomerGateway","AttachInternetGateway","CreateInternetGateway","DeleteInternetGateway","DetachInternetGateway")

description: Monitor for AWS VPC Customer/Internet Gateway configuration change.
